errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представя различни видове информационни системи
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis represents the types of information systems. The horizontal axis represents numerical values, while the vertical axis lists the systems.
The categories on the y-axis are not sorted alphabetically. For example, 'Електронна система...' is first, followed by 'Портал...', and then 'VPN...', which is not alphabetical order.
The category label is incorrectly transcribed. The chart shows 'Единен модел на електронни администрати...' (Unified model of electronic administration), not 'Единян на електронни администрации'.
The description lists six categories, repeating 'Портал за електронни административни услуги' at the end. The chart only contains five distinct categories.
The horizontal axis has tick marks at intervals of 10 units (0, 10, 20, 30, 40), not 5 percent.
The chart shows the percentage for this bar is 78,3%, not 36,3%. The absolute value is 36.
The bar with an absolute value of 29 corresponds to 63% in the chart, not 78,3%.
The description lists a bar with a value of 10, but no such bar exists in the chart.

errors.text_span: Всички стълбове са подредени от най-ниската до най-високата стойност.
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted by value in any order. The values from top to bottom are 36, 29, 12, 23, and 22, which is not a sorted sequence.
